}}'''Gueyam''' was a [[High Lord]] of [[Tear]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Gueyam}}

== Appearance ==
He is bald, with a broad face and an oiled beard.

== Activities ==
He is sent with the army of Tear to restore order to [[Cairhien]].{{ref/book|4|21}}

=== Fealty ===
After the battle with the [[Shaido]] in [[Cairhien]], Gueyam, along with the High Lords [[Aracome]], [[Hearne]], [[Maraconn]], [[Simaan]] and [[Torean]], swore fealty to [[Rand al'Thor]].

He goes with Rand when Rand tries to deal with the [[Illian]] rebels loyal to Lord Brend.
He rides with Rand when Rand's forces attack the invading [[Seanchan]] just outside Illian. He follows [[Davram Bashere]] into the final assault on the Seanchan. It is assumed that he does not survive this battle.

== Viewing ==
[[Min]] had a viewing that Aracome, Maraconn and Gueyam were going to die bloody deaths in battle. This viewing has been fulfilled for all of them, with Gueyam dying in a battle with the [[Seanchan]].
